headline: Vaulted Deep secures US$35m offtake-backed debt facility to scale biomass carbon removal
summary: Bio-waste carbon-removal developer Vaulted Deep closed a US$35m debt facility from Mediobanca, arranged by CFP Energy and secured against long-term CDR purchase and waste-servicing contracts with Frontier Climate buyers (Google, Stripe and others). The company said it is the largest publicly disclosed US commercial debt deal in durable carbon removal backed by long-term purchase contracts, and that it delivered 20,000 tonnes of removals to Frontier buyers in H1 2026.
co2crc_note: Signals a maturing offtake-backed debt-finance model for durable CDR — a non-dilutive capital template relevant as Australian CDR/CCS developers seek project finance.
extractor_note: Debt facility, not equity (mapped to nearest vocab 'investment'). US outlets (ESG Dive) dated the announcement 21 Sep 2026; carbonherald full timestamp 2026-09-22T12:47Z converts to 22 Sep Melbourne, the in-window date used here. 20,000 t is an H1-2026 delivery figure, not annual capacity, so capacity_mtpa left null.
